why: The products cover different periods. Comparing their full records would confound product with period, because the non-overlapping tail is a seasonally non-random slice. Every statistic below is computed on district-days present in both series.
aggregation_caveat: UCSB CHIRPS v2.0 Final district means are area-weighted (ClimateSERV, server-side); NASA IMERG Final Run v07 district means are unweighted means of 0.1-degree cell centres inside each district. This comparison therefore differs in aggregation as well as in product.
